messages:
Lucy: Quick preflight — planning to cut release/1.15 next Tue (Apr 6) 21:00 UTC. Need alignment on three things: version-bump owner, changelog PR flow, and cherry-pick/backport rules after RC.
Tom: I can take the branch-cut step (create release/1.15) unless someone else volunteers.
Rachel: For changelog: please open a single CHANGELOG.md PR against main with all entries, add the `changelog/for-release` label. I'll review and merge before cut.
Priya: Backport policy proposal: no feature cherry-picks after RC. Post-RC only bugfix/security/backport/patch with label `backport/critical` or `backport/patch`. Must include original PR link + reason.
Dave: Question — doc-only PRs (typos, small docs) merged after cut: do they go into release branch or wait for next minor?
Lucy: Doc-only: if merged to main before cutoff they'll be part of the branch. After cutoff, doc-only changes should target release/1.15 if they are blocking customer-facing docs; otherwise queue them for next release.
Tom: I suggest we automate label checks during PR merge to enforce backport tags. We can add a CI check that blocks merging PRs with `merge/after-freeze` without `backport/*` label. Thoughts?
Priya: +1 to the CI check. Also we should publish a tiny checklist in the release doc so non-release engineers know the rules.
Rachel: I'll own the changelog merge window: open PR by Mon 12:00 UTC, freeze edits at Mon 18:00 UTC. That gives me time to review before your Tue cut.
Lucy: Perfect. So owners: Tom = branch cut, Rachel = changelog merge, Priya = backport triage (label enforcement). Ops: Tom, please post the branch creation commands in the thread when you cut.
Tom: Will do. Branch creation snippet I'll use:```bash
git fetch origin
git checkout -b release/1.15 origin/main
git push origin release/1.15
```
eng-bot: Reminder: remember to update `versions.txt` and the package `__version__` bump PR should target the release branch after it's created unless it's landed on main before cut.
Dave: FYI — I have a small runtime improvement PR that touches feature flags. It's not a feature-perf change, but may be borderline. Should I open as candidate for backport/patch now?
Priya: If it fixes a regression or reduces error surface, label `backport/patch` and ping me. Otherwise keep it on main.
deploy-bot: Created checklist doc: https://redwood/internal/releases/1.15/checklist — contains owner assignments + merge window times.
Lucy: Action items summarized: 1) Tom cuts branch Tue 21:00 UTC and posts commands + branch URL in this thread. 2) Rachel opens/merges changelog PR by Mon 18:00 UTC freeze. 3) Priya triages backport labels and runs CI label check. 4) eng-bot note: version bumps go to release branch after cut unless landed on main earlier.
Tom: Ok I'm on call for the cut window. Will post branch URL once pushed.
Rachel: I'll queue the changelog PR Monday morning.
Priya: I'll draft the CI label check rule and post it here for review.
Dave: Thanks all — will tag PR with the suggested label if applicable.
Lucy: Thanks team :rocket: — keeping this thread for final confirmations.
